mapper.sql: select d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.dept_type, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.grade_year, d.education_level, d.study_years, d.class_remark from sys_dept d
mapper.select:
select d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.parent_id, d.status, d.create_time, d.grade_year, d.education_level, d.study_years, d.class_remark, p.dept_name as parent_name from sys_dept d left join sys_dept p on p.dept_id = d.parent_id and p.del_flag = '0' where d.del_flag = '0' and d.dept_type = 'CLASS'
and find_in_set(#{parentId}, d.ancestors)
and d.dept_name like concat('%', #{deptName}, '%')
and d.status = #{status}
${params.dataScope} order by d.create_time desc, d.dept_id desc

select d.dept_id, d.parent_id, d.ancestors, d.dept_name, d.dept_type, d.order_num, d.leader, d.phone, d.email, d.status, d.del_flag, d.grade_year, d.education_level, d.study_years, d.class_remark, d.create_time, (select dept_name from sys_dept where dept_id = d.parent_id) parent_name from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId}
where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.del_flag = '0' for update
select dept_id from sys_dept where del_flag = '0' and (dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)) order by dept_id for update
select user_id from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and dept_id in order by user_id for update
select rd.role_id from sys_role_dept rd join sys_role r on r.role_id = rd.role_id where r.del_flag = '0' and rd.dept_id in order by rd.role_id, rd.dept_id for update
mapper.update: update sys_user set dept_id = null, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where del_flag = '0' and dept_id in
mapper.delete: delete rd from sys_role_dept rd join sys_role r on r.role_id = rd.role_id where r.del_flag = '0' and rd.dept_id in
mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user u where u.dept_id = #{deptId} and u.del_flag = '0' and exists ( select 1 from sys_user_role ur join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = u.user_id and r.role_key = 'teacher' and r.del_flag = '0' )
select * from sys_dept where find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
select count(*) from sys_dept where status = 0 and del_flag = '0' and find_in_set(#{deptId}, ancestors)
where dept_name=#{deptName} and parent_id = #{parentId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept( dept_id, parent_id, dept_name, dept_type, grade_year, education_level, study_years, class_remark, ancestors, order_num, leader, phone, email, status, create_by, create_time )values( #{deptId}, #{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{deptType}, #{gradeYear}, #{educationLevel}, #{studyYears}, #{classRemark}, #{ancestors}, #{orderNum}, #{leader}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update sys_dept set status = '0' where dept_id in
#{deptId}
update sys_dept set order_num = #{orderNum} where dept_id = #{deptId}

update sys_dept set del_flag = '2' where del_flag = '0' and dept_id in and not exists (select 1 from sys_user where del_flag = '0' and dept_id in ) and not exists (select 1 from sys_role_dept rd join sys_role r on r.role_id = rd.role_id where r.del_flag = '0' and rd.dept_id in )
